milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The jack_o_lanterns are at spawn-relative (5, 1, 6) and (5, 2, 6). Target is set to (5, 1, 6) (the lower jack_o_lantern at eye level). The player must navigate near it and face toward it to confirm they have found it. max_distance=10 requires the player to approach the structure rather than just spotting it from spawn. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is intentionally looking at the lantern.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The lime_concrete_powder blocks are at spawn-relative (7, 0, 7), (8, 0, 7), and (7, 0, 8). Target is set to (7, 0, 7) as the nearest block in the cluster. The player must navigate near it and face toward it. max_distance=10 requires intentional approach toward the powder after finding the lantern. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the green blocks specifically, not just the nearby lantern.
